# Kredibly

> Kredibly is an online store builder and social-commerce storefront platform for Nigerian merchants selling on WhatsApp, Instagram, and TikTok, operated by Akinbyte Technologies Limited.

## Overview
- Website: https://usekredibly.com
- Support Email: support@usekredibly.com
- Country & Currency: Nigeria (NGN / ₦)
- Core Purpose: Help social media sellers launch an official online storefront in minutes, replace messy DM ordering with structured carts and instant checkout, track inventory, and receive payouts via Nomba.

## Pricing Plans (NGN)
- Starter (Free): ₦0/month — up to 20 products, 2.5% transaction fee on checkout orders.
- Starter Plus: ₦5,000/month — up to 50 products, 0% Kredibly commission on orders.
- Deluxe (Pro): ₦10,000/month — up to 200 products, 0% Kredibly commission, custom domain support, and advanced storefront features.
- Ultimate (Scale): ₦20,000/month — 1,000+ products, 0% Kredibly commission, priority support, and full scale tooling.

## Key Capabilities
- Instant storefront URL (`usekredibly.com/your-store` or custom domain on higher plans)
- Built-in online checkout and bank/card payments powered by Nomba
- WhatsApp-ready product links, order receipts, and customer order tracking
- Merchant dashboard for products, variants, inventory, orders, and payouts
- Custom website builds for brands needing bespoke storefronts
